description.value: 12 Baskets Nutrition & Health Co is a natural health and supplement retailer in Richmond, BC, stocking an extensive lineup of vitamins, herbs, probiotics, homeopathic remedies, and natural beauty products from dozens of Canadian and international brands. The store also carries a food section with superfoods, dried fruits, nuts, seeds, natural condiments, and manuka honey — useful resupply items for a touring cyclist. It operates both a physical retail location and an active online store with Canada-wide shipping.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 53m; stands at 55m; rack at 65m; rack at 76m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.12baskets.com/ is active and operational, confirming the business exists and is open, with current promotions listed. The site is primarily a supplement and natural health products retailer but also carries food items including dried fruits, nuts, seeds, condiments, superfoods, and manuka honey, supporting a partial 'basic groceries' claim. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content. One subpage title references 'Health Food Stores Burnaby' despite the OSM address being in Richmond, flagged as a concern.
concerns: One website subpage title reads 'Health Food Stores Burnaby' despite the OSM record placing the store in Richmond — may be SEO metadata for a second location or a metadata error; physical address should be verified on-site.
Phone number listed in OSM (+16042701838) was not corroborated in the fetched website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active health food and supplement retailer with a confirmed operational website and physical address in Richmond; useful to touring cyclists for food resupply.
